modeHintAuto: Auto: ANIMA uses the best brain available right now, walking the ladder until one answers — online AI (if you have a key), the model on your browser GPU, the browser brain with the web index, then the Cardputer, which may use its own online tier.
modeHintPrivate: Private: the same ladder with every network step removed — the browser GPU model, the browser brain with already-cached web cards only, and the Cardputer answering offline. Nothing leaves this machine.
modeFieldSub: Whether ANIMA may use the network: Auto uses it when it helps, Private never does.
modeChain: Auto walks one ladder until a brain answers: online AI (with a key) → the model on your browser GPU → the browser brain (WASM + web index) → the Cardputer. Private is the same ladder with every network step removed. Type /guide for the full map.
webPrivate: The 🌐 Web search needs the network — switch the mode to Auto to use it.
tutModeBullet: For online answers, weather and news keep the mode on Auto (⚙ Settings · Engine); Private never uses the network.
stoppedNote: stopped — the answer above is incomplete
streamCut: the connection dropped — the answer may be incomplete
thinkingStatus: ANIMA is working on the answer…
copyUnavailable: Copying is blocked on this plain-HTTP page — the text is selected: press Ctrl+C (⌘C).
secTitle: This page is served over plain HTTP, so the browser turns some features off.
secFix: To turn them on in Chrome or Edge, open chrome://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure, add {origin}, choose Enabled and relaunch the browser. Dictation also works with the Cardputer mic (Settings ▸ General).
agentHw: Hardware action (it acts in the real world): it is always confirmed.
agentIrrev: Irreversible or system-level action: it is always confirmed, even with auto-approve on.
wsAskBody: The agent is about to create files. Open a workspace so they stay visible here? Otherwise they go to the temporary /data/agent folder.
downloadModelQ: Download {m} (~{gb} GB) into this browser? It happens once; afterwards it runs offline on your GPU.
gpuTight: May not fit the GPU: it wants ~{need} GB of VRAM. If it fails, pick a smaller model.
gpuOff_insecure: WebGPU is off: this page is served over plain HTTP and the browser only allows it on secure pages.
gpuOff_blocked: The browser has WebGPU but finds no usable GPU (hardware acceleration off or GPU not supported).
gpuFix_insecure:
To turn it on in Chrome or Edge:
1. Open {flag} (paste it in the address bar).
2. In the box type {origin}
3. Choose Enabled and press Relaunch.
gpuFix_browser: Use an up-to-date Chrome or Edge (version 113 or later) on a computer. Firefox and Safari have it only in their newest versions.
gpuFix_blocked:
How to fix it:
1. Browser settings ▸ System: turn on "Use graphics acceleration" and relaunch the browser.
2. Open chrome://gpu: next to WebGPU it must say "Hardware accelerated".
3. If the GPU is too old, the local model cannot run on this computer: use another one.
gpuMeanwhile: Meanwhile ANIMA still answers: the in-browser brain, the Cardputer, and the cloud if you have a key.
gpuDlgTitle: Why the GPU model won’t start
gpuCopied: Copied: paste it in the address bar.
gpuCopyNo: The browser blocked copying: type {flag} by hand
gpuLoadOom: The GPU does not have enough memory for {m}: pick a smaller model and press again.
gpuLoadFail: Failed ({e}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the connection or pick a smaller model.

voiceInsecure: Browser-mic dictation needs a secure context. On {origin} pick the Cardputer mic in Settings ▸ General, or in Chrome/Edge open chrome://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure, add {origin}, choose Enabled and relaunch the browser.
voicePrivate: In Private mode the browser’s speech recognition is off: it sends the audio to a cloud service. Use the Cardputer mic (Settings ▸ General) or switch to Auto.
guideMinds:
ANIMA tries its brains in order, from the most capable to the always-available, and asks the Cardputer only as the last safety net:
☁ 1 · Online AI — Claude/Groq/Grok, needs a key and the Internet.
✦ 2 · Browser GPU — a full language model on your graphics card (WebLLM), once installed.
◆ 3 · Browser brain + web index — the Cardputer’s offline cascade compiled to WebAssembly and run on your CPU; when it doesn’t know, it looks the answer up on Wikipedia from the browser.
▣ 4 · Cardputer — the on-device brain, the final net.
guideModes: Auto walks the whole ladder. Private removes every network step: no online AI, no live web lookups (only already-cached cards), and the Cardputer answers offline. Switch with the mode pill, /auto or /private. Device actions — volume, reminders, the time — always go to the Cardputer first, because only it can do them.
guideTeach: Say “remember that the meeting room is on the third floor” or “my name is Marco”. Personal facts are kept by the Cardputer, so every browser sees them; while the Cardputer is unreachable they wait in this browser and are handed over as soon as it answers.
guidePrivacy: In Private mode nothing leaves this machine and your Cardputer. With a key, online calls go straight from your browser to the provider — never through the device, never logged.
